verdict.rationale: GitLab's technology-partner directory lists third-party security scanners that integrate with GitLab: Semgrep, CodeAnt AI (SAST/SCA in merge requests), and Aqua Trivy, which became GitLab's default container scanning engine. The platform also claims to consolidate SAST, SCA, Secret Detection and DAST scanners in one place. Nothing in the pack shows an in-product security tab or marketplace where these integrations can be installed directly; the directory is a marketing page, and the only one-click install evidence covers cluster apps, not scanners. Missing for 10: an in-product security tab or marketplace install flow for third-party scanners, documentation of the install or enablement steps, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
